request.prompt: Which humanoid robots can be purchased in Asia?

result.text:
Several humanoid and bipedal robots developed by Asian tech companies are commercially available for purchase, primarily targeting research institutions, software developers, and industrial automation markets.

Prominent humanoid robots manufactured and sold in Asia include:

1. Unitree Robotics (China)

Unitree is one of the most prominent suppliers of accessible bipedal robots globally, offering models widely used for AI development and research:

Unitree G1: A compact humanoid robot (roughly 1.3 meters tall) that stands as one of the most cost-effective humanoid platforms on the market, starting around $16,000 to $17,900. Higher-tier educational configurations (EDU versions) feature advanced multi-finger dexterous hands and higher-end processing.

Unitree H1 / H2 Series: Full-sized humanoid robots built for heavier industrial payloads, robust mobility, and advanced AI integration.

2. Booster Robotics (China)

Booster K1: An agile, compact bipedal humanoid robot aimed at education, developer prototyping, and research, typically ranging from roughly $11,000 to $20,000 depending on the software tier.

3. UBTECH Robotics (China)

Walker & Cruzr Series: UBTECH manufactures commercial service humanoids (such as the Cruzr series) as well as industrial-grade bipedal systems (Walker S series) utilized in automotive manufacturing lines. They also produce specialized bionic humanoid models for interactive environments.

4. Fourier Intelligence (China)

GR-2: A general-purpose, human-sized humanoid robot designed for advanced movement, rehabilitation research, and complex manipulation tasks.

5. Kawada Robotics (Japan)

Nextage: A well-established Japanese dual-arm humanoid robot designed primarily for precision industrial assembly, electronics manufacturing, and factory collaboration.

Are you looking for a humanoid robot for a specific application like academic research, software development, or industrial automation?
